summary: Xero uses OAuth 2.0 with granular scopes for API access, requiring a Xero user account to register and manage applications. Certain sensitive scopes, such as Bank Feeds, Finance API, and Practice Manager, require additional certification or partnership agreements.

verdict.label: Moderate
verdict.approval_required: Certain scopes like payment services, bank feeds, finance API, account data API, and practice manager API require additional certification, agreements, or registering as an app partner.

prerequisites.text: Sign up for a free Xero account

steps.title: Create a Xero Account
steps.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account if you do not already have one.

steps.title: Enable the Demo Company
steps.detail: Enable the Xero demo company to use for testing and exploration.

steps.title: Add an OAuth 2.0 Application
steps.detail: Add your OAuth 2.0 application, which will prompt you to log into Xero first.

steps.title: Determine Required Scopes
steps.detail: Identify and request the minimum granular scopes required for your specific integration actions.

steps.title: Request Offline Access If Needed
steps.detail: Include the offline_access scope if your application requires a refresh token.

approval.summary: Certain scopes and API categories trigger additional certification, agreements, or application partner status before they can be used in production.

blockers.problem: Cannot remove scopes from an existing access token directly.
blockers.fix: Revoke the token and start the authentication flow again to reduce consented scopes.

agent_can: Prepare integration code using SDKs and sample apps
you_must: Log into Xero to register and add an OAuth 2.0 application
Handle user consent and authorization flows
uncertain: Specific account types and app types configuration rules
Exact reviewer identity and published wait times for approvals
Rate limits and connection limits before approval
